sweep_findings.human_review_bounds_note: Scenarios a and b are theoretical upper bounds because reviewers are assumed to contest 100% of reviewed cases. At base-case p=₹4,150, Scenario b nets ₹17.49L, falling below Contest Everything (₹18.64L) because contesting virtually all cases incurs ₹166,350 in review fees while avoiding only 12 losses.
sweep_findings.winner_at_base_p: Live Policy (Automated-Only) achieves ₹28.77L, beating Contest Everything (₹18.64L) by +₹10.12L at base-case penalty p=₹4,150.00.
sweep_findings.winner_at_p0: Contest Everything (Unconstrained) achieves the highest unpenalized recovery (₹108.95L) because filing cost (₹150) is trivial relative to dispute size (~₹4,000).
